sources.exe_file: the build output name; stage/BurnoutMashup.exe compared byte for byte when present
sources.exe_sha256: sha256 of <build>/bin/burnout3.exe (verify.py: identical to EXPECTED.json build.exe_sha256)
sources.format: schema of the release's kit_tools/make_host_info.py (format 1); additive fields are ignored by bmcompat.py
sources.host_name: = identity (a build has no other name)
sources.identity: the string bmp-<platform>+<12 hex> read from the exe's bytes; equals bo3_build_id.h, build_result.json and the recomputed digest of the source tree
sources.inputs.anchors_json_sha256: sha256 of host/marks/anchors.json of the checkout, equal to host/PINS.json marks.anchors_sha256
sources.inputs.bm_gen_access_h_sha256: sha256 of <host tree>/src/game/bm_gen_access.h, equal to host/PINS.json marks.header_sha256
sources.inputs.takedawn_*, inputs.xboxrecomp_*: host/PINS.json (checked by fetch_upstream.py against the fetched archives; not re-derived here)
sources.platform: BO3_PLATFORM_VERSION in <host tree>/src/game/bm_platform_table.h (also the platform part of the identity)
sources.source_digest_sha256: recomputed from the files of the host tree on disk (cmake/bo3_source_id.cmake's rule) + the build's bo3_build_config.txt; equals the digest of the build's bo3_build_manifest.txt
sources.source_files: number of files the two digests were taken over (counted while recomputing them)
sources.tables: T(name, version, keys) rows of the same file
sources.toolchain: <build>.logs/build_result.json (tool versions queried by build.ps1; checked against EXPECTED.json by verify.py)
sources.toolkit_identity: digest of the toolkit tree files (same rule); equals the 'toolkit' line of the build manifest
sources.verification: verify.py run on this build with EXPECTED.json

verification.exe: identical to the reference in EXPECTED.json
